title: Ye That Obey the Immortal King
description: Ye That Obey the Immortal King in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 18 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Daily and nightly Devotion”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Ye that o-bey th'im-mor-tal King, At-tend his ho-ly place; Bow to the glo-ries of his name, And sing his won-drous grace.

lines: Ye that obey the immortal King,
Bow to the glories of his name,
Lift up your hands by morning light,
And raise your thanks on high;
Send your admiring thoughts, by night,
The God of Zion cheer your hearts
'Tis he that spreads the heavens abroad,

licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
